data.attribution: Rishabh Misra, News Category Dataset; original HuffPost articles; mirror heegyu/news-category-dataset
data.split: per-category content-SHA256 order: first floor(n/5) calibration, remainder evaluation
limitations: Cross-source category mapping is related, not identical to AG News.
No retraining or target-specific label calibration; this is an external model-transfer test.
Non-ASCII tokenization and 128-token truncation preserve the original source-model boundary.

all.interpretation: 95% paired document bootstrap conditional on the three fitted models; no seed-independence assumption.
